opportunity to work for a leading Dutch company in high-end crane and hoisting equipment; A professional workplace in the Porto region; International collaboration with experienced engineers in the Netherlands; Room to grow technically and professionally; A role where your work directly contributes to safe and reliable lifting systems; Support from Xelvin Portugal during your onboarding and development. Functie-eisen We are looking for an engineer with a strong technical mindset and a practical approach to electrical design.
